title: Add AOM artifact detail and trust status panel
verified: AOM artifact detail renders coordinate, kind, publisher, version, digests, trust tier and source evidence.
Artifact state explains registry-only, staged-inert, active, blocked-revoked and blocked-incompatible states.
Activation preview remains gated with activation_prepared=false, direct_activate=false and SecurityExecutionEngine required.
TUI does not own AOM resolver logic and renders resolver_owner=agent_core::ecosystem.
Command palette preview for aom.artifact.show is read-only and does not create run snapshots.
risk_notes: AOM artifact panel consumes local registry, staging and active-set evidence only.
No resolver, activation planner, policy or side-effect authority was added to TUI.
Revoked and incompatible artifacts are visibly blocked and cannot appear directly launchable.
Stage/install remains inert; activation requires AgentCore PlanSpec, SecurityExecutionEngine, approval and rollback.
